gate: H1b-1b Maynard Lemma 8.2 and GGPY/HR multiplier recovery
scope: An exact project proof makes Maynard Lemma 8.2 explicit for the H1b-1a cutoff and a conditional partial-summation contract transfers a future explicit GGPY Lemma 3 constant into Lemma 4 at kappa=1. The Halberstam-Richert base multiplier and finite range remain unavailable, so this is not a numerical basic-summation package or theorem threshold certificate.

obligation_updates.reason: The H1b-1a cutoff yields the uniform explicit multiplier 89 for both parts of Maynard Lemma 8.2.
At kappa=1, an explicit Lemma 3 multiplier C3 transfers to Lemma 4 with safe factor 2, but C3 and its range remain open.
The cited HR Lemmas 5.3-5.4 were located at printed pages 144 and 147-152, but the full proof pages were not legally accessible in the available preview.
The complete displayed Lemma 8.2 error shape now has a project-certified uniform multiplier 89; later substitutions remain separate obligations.

remaining_blockers: recover an explicit C3(A1,A2) and common z range from HR Lemmas 5.3-5.4, including any applicable errata
instantiate Maynard Lemma 8.4 values A1, A2 and L
bound the Lemma 8.4 test-function norm and r-fold accumulation on one common range
complete Lemma 8.1(ii), H1c-1, moment formulas and every other root dependency before any X_cert calculation

next_gate.primary: Obtain and audit HR Sieve Methods printed pages 144-152, preferably pages 140-153 plus the relevant errata/notes, then reconstruct C3(A1,A2) without treating O-constants as one.
next_gate.after_source_recovery: Compose the recovered C3 with the factor-2 GGPY transfer and audit Maynard Lemma 8.4 gamma, L, smoothness and iteration rows.
